run_multiprocess_train: run multi-GPU distributed training using the multiprocessing_train Parlai script with a transformer model
run_mp_train_alias: run multi-GPU training using the mp_train alias for the multiprocessing_train script
launch_and_train_fork: launch multiple subprocesses to fork and run distributed training across GPUs
setup_distributed_args: setup argument parser with distributed training args defaulting to the number of available GPUs
review_multiprocess_train_function: review the multiprocess_train function that initializes distributed context and runs the FSDP training loop
